local-session-list.json.note: The default session's socket_path is ~/.config/herdr/herdr.sock, NOT under sessions/. This is the case SocketPath.forSession used to get wrong.

multi-session-list.json.note: Same shape as the live capture, extended with a named session and a stopped session. Creating real named sessions requires launching interactive herdr servers, so the extra entries mirror the documented `herdr session list` columns (name/status/directory/socket) rather than being captured.
